whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Delhi Story,

I noticed your cafe/restaurant has strong 4.2★ reviews from 400+ food lovers at City Center Mall in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online table reservations and menu exploration.

Maine aapke outlet ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, popular menu highlights, aur route directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/delhistory

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Delhi Story, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha at City Center Mall, Chajju Bagh. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first menu display, and customer review highlights. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur timings setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
